summary: Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC filed an 8-K disclosing entry into material definitive agreements for a securitization transaction. The registrant, as depositor, and Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-B, as issuing entity, entered into an indenture, trust agreement, receivables purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement, administration agreement, control agreement, and asset representations review agreement for the issuance of asset-backed securities. The filing is a routine current report for an ABS issuance, not a special situation.
